title: $q$-deformation of the Marchenko-Pastur law
summary: We study a $q$-deformed random unitary ensemble associated with the little-$q$ Laguerre weight, which provides a discrete analogue of the classical Laguerre unitary ensemble. In the double scaling regime $q=e^{-λ/N}$, where $N$ is the system size and $λ\ge 0$, we derive the limiting spectral distribution as $N\to \infty$, which yields a $q$-deformation of the Marchenko-Pastur law. The limiting density undergoes a phase transition at an explicitly determined critical value $λ_c$: for $λ λ_c$ an additional saturated region emerges adjacent to the band region.
